note: Ambiguities were annotated before any evaluation run (attendance-app had one pilot run during development). Do not edit after running; add a new version instead.
promptSuffix: For now, only describe your plan and technology choices; do not create any files.

scenarios.prompt: Create a simple attendance tracker. Students can be added and marked present.

ambiguities.countsIf: any persistence choice: database, file, localStorage, in-memory
web vs CLI vs desktop, or a framework/stack choice
whether users log in, or who may mark attendance

scenarios.prompt: Build a todo list app where I can add, complete and delete tasks.

ambiguities.countsIf: where tasks are saved, or that they are lost on reload

scenarios.prompt: Add a login screen to my web app.

ambiguities.countsIf: hashing algorithm or where credentials live
cookies vs JWT vs session store

scenarios.prompt: Write a small REST API for managing books in a library.

ambiguities.countsIf: local disk vs object storage vs database

scenarios.prompt: Make a note-taking app that works on my laptop and phone.

ambiguities.countsIf: how notes sync between devices, or a backend/cloud choice
native vs web/PWA vs cross-platform framework

scenarios.prompt: Send students an email reminder the day before an assignment is due.

ambiguities.countsIf: where student emails and due dates come from

scenarios.prompt: Generate a monthly sales report from our orders data.

ambiguities.countsIf: input format or data source (CSV, database, API)
currency, tax, refunds or time zone handling

scenarios.prompt: Add a chat feature so users can message each other.

ambiguities.countsIf: WebSockets vs polling vs a hosted service
blocking, reporting, or privacy of messages

scenarios.prompt: Let customers pay for their orders on my shop website.

ambiguities.countsIf: whether card data touches our server (PCI scope)

scenarios.prompt: Add search to our product catalogue.

ambiguities.countsIf: database LIKE/full-text vs search engine choice
assumed catalogue size or performance target

scenarios.prompt: Get my Node.js app online so my friends can use it.
